messages:
zara khan: Quick sync 1: were enabling org-fallback for API keys in staging canary (15%). Need clear rollback/alerting criteria before we open to prod.

leo park: Agreed. What metrics are we watching?

zara khan: Minimal set:
- auth.decision.fallback_count
- project.auth.fallback_rate (per-project p95)
- auth.latency.p50/p95 for routed requests
- auth.error.invalid_key_count
Also spike in support mentions (#support).

kevin wu: Suggest thresholds: fallback_rate > 2% org-wide for 10m OR any single project fallback_rate > 5% for 5m -> auto-alert. Also if latency p95 increases >50ms over baseline -> alert.

anya singh: How do we detect "silent" billing shifts? If fallback starts attributing to org, customers might hit org quota unexpectedly. Need a billing delta metric.

zara khan: Good call. Add metric: billing.auth.attributed_to_org_counter and billing.auth.attributed_to_project_counter. We'll compare rate ratios.

leo park: Where does the console show this? We should add a small heatmap on the Keys page and a global banner when canary is active. Also make the per-project fallback_rate link to sampled traces.

zara khan: Console work is small for canary: banner + quick link to Grafana. Full UX (heatmap + traces inline) is tracked in PLAT-482. For now include a "Show sampled traces" modal that fetches traces by project id.

kevin wu: On rollback automation: ops-runbook recommends manual revert + postmortem. I can add an automation to flip canary percent back to 0 if alert fires, but only after 2x oncall ack within 5m. Safer.

zara khan: Agree. We'll keep manual + assisted rollback. Add an automated slack notification to #eng-platform if the automation triggers.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: routing-service v2.14 deployed to staging canary=15%  invoked by zara khan

anya singh: Can we log reason codes for fallback in a compact enum: MISSING_PROJECT_BINDING, INVALID_PROJECT_KEY, PROJECT_QUOTA_HIT? Makes aggregations easier.

zara khan: Done. Logs + metrics use that enum. We'll tag traces with reason and sampled_error=true for quota hits.

leo park: One more: ensure throttling semantics don't change. If project quota is exhausted and we fallback to org, org's quota should be consumed; but if org also exhausted we must fail fast with 429 and emit auth.decision.failed_quota.

zara khan: Yep that's the plan. Failure mode: 429 + reason=COALIGNED_QUOTA_EXHAUSTION.

kevin wu: OK. I'll create the alert rules and a dashboard panel and post links in #support before we go to prod.

zara khan: Thanks. We'll watch first 30m and converge here. If no issues, schedule prod rollout next week.
